items.title: DevFest Benin 2026: Connect, Learn, Innovate
items.text:
Date: 12 December 2026, 09:00 UTC
Ends: 12 December 2026, 15:00 UTC
Location: Victor Uwaifo Creative Hub & Sound Stage, Airport Road, Benin City
Registration: Free registration

Join us for DevFest Benin 2026, a dynamic gathering of tech enthusiasts and innovators at the heart of Benin City!

Engage with fellow developers, discover the latest in technology, and ignite your creativity. Let's shape the future together. Reserve your spot now and be part of this transformative experience!
